name: [🦖] Raise a Farm [UPDATE]
desc:
🐄 Welcome to Raise a Farm 🐄

Are you ready to Raise your very own Farm? Buy Eggs from the shop when they restock, Raise them, wait for them to Grow and collect the profits! Flex Animals and finds on friends, and have fun!

[How To Plant]
• Equip your Eggs you want to Raise!
• Click in your farm on the brown plots to Place!
• Wait to see it start growing!
• After its fully grown, it is time to harvest the goods! and Sell!

Remember, your Farm  literally grows while you are offline ⭐
Inspiration Game of Grow a Garden
